Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://pau.edu. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 26-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PAU Young Professional-1 recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the PAU Young Professional-1 recruitment is 26 August 2026. Candidates are advised to ensure their applications reach the designated address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Young Professional-1 post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Sc. degree in Medical, Biological Science, Microbiology, Agriculture, Biotechnology, Food Technology, Horticulture, or Forestry with at least 60% marks. Additionally, proficiency in Punjabi up to the Matriculation level is mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Young Professional-1 position?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Young Professional-1 post ranges from a minimum of 21 years to a maximum of 45 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per the government's recruitment rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional-1 post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Young Professional-1 position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 30,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the PAU Young Professional-1 recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official PAU website, fill it out correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it via Speed Post or Registered Post to the address specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Young Professional-1 post will primarily involve an interview followed by document verification. Candidates are advised to prepare well for the interview.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the PAU Young Professional-1 recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an application fee. General and OBC category candidates are required to pay Rs. 200/-. Specific details regarding payment methods are available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Young Professional-1 at Punjab Agricultural University is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the PAU located?
faq.answer: Punjab Agricultural University (PAU) is located in Ludhiana, Punjab, with the pincode 141004.

faq.question: Q10. When will the interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The interview for the Young Professional-1 recruitment is scheduled to be conducted on 01 September 2026.
